text: I do like playing this game. But get out your wallet! I'm convinced that it's built into the game that some of the levels have too many items, many items very small, and often are the same colors-impossible to differentiate them, match three, and clear them in the time frame allowed. In order to pass that level, you have to buy coins so you can pay your way out of the level by adding 60 seconds to the clock to finish. Otherwise, you start over! The game is fun, but I don't appreciate the cheat!

Horrible game once you get to level 700. You CAN NOT win unless you make in app purchases, which I ABSOLUTELY REFUSE to do. Even the "easy" levels after that are absolutely impossible to win!! 1 minute and 40 seconds to sift through multicolor objects?!? Nope, deleting now. Waste of time, and I'm definitely NOT wasting my money on a silly game.

I would love to give this more stars because it has loads of potential. The game itself is super fun! I stopped playing my other game (I'm the leader of a team) to play this one. But it's a money pit. The short games have lots of time, the harder games don't. There's no way to play more without paying. Support said the game is in testing. But there's nothing here that says so. Short story, someone is getting rich. Fun and even addictive but beware of the hand in your pocket!

Update: Yes there are some really hard levels and you begin to feel you will never pass. Eventually you will. I don't spend money in the game. As I move up the ladder I wish they would have more easier levels between the hard levels. Don't give up. It's a fun game. This is a fun game however, there are some very hard levels. I have been stuck on Level 129 for almost a week and that is playing a couple times a day.

Yes I'm over 60. But I only made it to level 123 before giving up & uninstalled this game. I've been stuck on a "ultra hard" level for over a week. Only way to get pass it is to spend money. I don't like to waste money on games. Sorry to say off it goes cause it really is a challenging game which I like. But this is too challenging for me.

Best graphics and background sounds, no ads and very addicting at first, BUT...it gets too hard eventually and the deals and sales cost too much. It's no longer fun when you can't get to the rewards by passing multiple levels in a row, and if I do get to rewards I lose them quickly. The easy levels become impossible at some point and you can't win them in one try. I would pay $2 to $5 for good offers, but I can't afford their "deals" at $24. 3 stars because it was a blast for awhile.

I enjoy this game a lot and think myself good at it. Unfortunately, after level 800 it becomes a cash grab. When the "normal" levels become challenging to pass without going through most or all of your lives, there's a problem. It will be impossible to complete events due to how many attempts each level needs. That is, unless purchases are made. I'm not anti-purchase, but I am when it is forced in this manner. It sucks the fun out of the game. I'll will be uninstalling if this continues.

First off, no ads? In 2026? almost automatic 5 star lol. I'm a little over level 1000, and I haven't seen one. the extra events don't get in my way and aren't over involved. The levels don't keep adding weird gimmicks. The game just...is. I want to play my tappy game so I play my tappy game and have fun. Wow, what a concept. I appreciate this game so much.

Match Factory is CRAZY addictive! The puzzles pull you in from the very first level — simple at first, then suddenly you’re locked in and strategizing like a pro. The graphics are clean, the animations are smooth, and I haven’t had a single crash. And the BEST part? It’s truly AD‑FREE. That alone keeps me playing for hours without stopping. This game is a whole vibe — perfect for quick breaks, winding down, or getting lost in it for way longer than you planned. Love it!

Its pretty sad how you have the game rigged for people to spend money. You make the Super hard, Extra hard very short on time but increase the amount of rhings you have to fond like for level 499. I was enjoying this game until then. Let people decide if they want to spend money on the game, don't rig the fame to force them to buy or delete the fame. Thats Pathetic!!

Once you get to level 2500 or so, the levels just become impossible to pass. They don't give you enough time. I have gotten super quick at this game, but the levels truly are impossible to pass without purchasing boosters. I love this game, but sadly I will be deleting it now. there's just no point in playing anymore, because it's not possible to pass the levels.

I just read some of the other reviews. And I totally agree what the low star, because this game it's rigged for you to lose and to pay or it's over. My experience When I'm selecting certain ones with my Samsung pin, it hits different things, and I know good and well that I didn't select those items, which causes you to lose, and I'm thinking in my head that this pin is so tiny, how is it mistakenly clicking something else. Especially on hard levels!!!

Increasingly DIFFICULT! This game was so fun to play when starting out. It became challenging with more game play, as expected. Once you get to level 1500, you can hang it up. It becomes a total money grab. There's no way you get off those levels without spending money. It's also near impossible to complete a particular challenge within the game because if you fail 1 board, you have to start over. It was fun while it lasted. Game over!

I thought that playing games was suppose to be relaxing, but this one increases my anxiety to an extreme amount! I don't think it's fair that the super hard and the ultra hard levels have to be short while the easy levels get to be long. And what's worse, no matter how quickly I try to clear it out without trying to rush, It still ends up saying "Out of Space" and I never have enough coins to clear it out! The only thing I love about this game is that there are no ads! That's about it!

This game is fun until it's not. I've managed to make it to level 2027 w/o spending a dime untill now. w/o the super ball some levels are impossible to pass w/o spending $$$. Being color blind makes this game even more challenging. There are subtle color variations that are just enough to throw you off & no color blind mode. Im at a point where the level is not passable without spending real money as the time for the level is too short. Probably going to uninstall. It was fun while it lasted.

The 'Duck Cards' ruined a great game. This use to be a great game. Now after every level, you have to watch a stupid animation, or two or three, or four, of "Duck Card" packs that you "won" being ripped open and the cards removed. These sometimes go on for several minutes while you wait to start the next level. Play for 2 minutes. watch 2-4 minutes of useless animation. PLEASE! Just let me start playing the next level.

the game is fun and challenging and free to play. 1 star is due to the devs putting BOTS into the game that you race against to complete levels. they are 80% of the time impossible to beat as they jump levels of completion and win the race so you cannot get the reward (powerups) for free. the devs want you to BUY the powerups instead of winning them in a fair race. I feel it is deceitful to players.

Strange thing. Reached over 10k levels, and one day, when I opened it, progress was gone. I went in circles with support. Their answer? Just log in with your google account...except I was still logged in with my google account. No response. Stranger still, I am now invincible in this game. Over 10k points, ridiculous # of boosters, etc. Difficulty is ridiculously easy, and I haven't had to buy anything since the glitch. There should be something between impossible and boring...so, uninstalling.

Edit: Dropping my review to 3 stars because support for this game is extremely unhelpful. I've played for over a year and I've noticed there are some very glitchy, unfairly tough levels. I'd love to see more mini games within the main game to help us earn coins and boosters and to keep the game interesting. Also please review the difficulty of some levels because they are literally impossible to beat without waiting until your coin level is 100+ or spending actual money on the game.

This game is addictive but as you go up in levels, the board gets more difficult to pass and that is because the developers want you to spend money to get the items to help you pass it. But the one thing that pisses me off the most is that I know when I press an item I need, it chooses a different item and makes you lose. That's why the 3 stars

I love that there are no ads and I love that the game is entertaining BUT the algorithm is set so that I get the superball on a Super Hard level EVERYTIME. It would be better to start the superball on say a medium or easy level and then work up so you arent pretty much guaranteed to loose unless you pay money. I do agree with another player that the "Times up" or "Out of Space' covers what you did/need . If you could see what else you need you might pay $ to continue.

This game is kind of addictive. i like the challenge. though it takes too long to build up coins and the stuff you can get cost most of your coins. you get a lot of other stuff but not enough coins compared to the amount of the challenges you have to complete just to get 50 or 100 coins. most things cost 100 coins or more. so then you're tempted to actually PAY your real money just for coins and other items. keep in mind this is just a game where you don't win any real money... dont get hooked!

this game was fun and easy to play until level 2000, where it got absurdly difficult. I had over 10,000 coins and 100 of each boost saved until then. Within 100 more levels I had to use up everything I saved. It takes 10 lives until the game finally lessens the stuff you have to sort through so the level is actually winnable. it is extremely frustrating now and not even worth playing.

well I use to love this game ...changed to a new phone backed up everything, THOUGHT it saved my progress, even the tech that transferred my phone made sure I was good. I was on level 2854!! a lot of money and time spent and I lost it all!! they claim they can't restore my progress! so anyone that plays this game I'd use caution cause I had receipts and everything and still can't seem to get even a straight answer.

The multiple attempts hearts for 15, 30 min, 1hr, sometimes ending up about 2hrs are a bit inconvenient sometimes because it looks like they can't be paused when you need to exit the game until later. And only 5 attempts, then waiting, otherwise is too stingy for some of the Super Hard levels, so it's not really a game I can enjoy or relax much with, i have to be rather caffeinated to get through those levels eventually without needing to pay. I'm only tolerating it because of freecash.

I enjoy playing this game, but at a certain point, the levels get impossible! even harder than before. yes, the game should get progressively harder, but this is ridiculous. as the game goes on, you stay on boards for longer and longer and the game pretty much leaves you high and dry. the power ups become non existent or even the opportunities to aquire power ups disappears. literally the only way to pass a board is to buy coins. it seems like at a certain point, it's a scam. it's disappointing.

This game is too easy at first, so it hooks you... then after you reach level 1,000 or so, bam! You have NO WAY of moving on without spending REAL MONEY. The level I'm on right now (2149) is absolutely impossible. I've spent waaaay too much actual money. Shame on the developers. I don't mind spending $$ every now & then, and when I think the game is worth it... but dang... you all are vultures. I want to uninstall, but... the game is unlike any other match game! Ugh... you've been warned, lol!

the game itself is a lot of fun. the money grab, however, is not. the first 1000 levels or so are mostly challenging, but still fun. after that comes the money grab. when you come across THAT level and lose all your coins & boosters the fun is over. there are levels that cannot even be cleared with the purchase of 5 xtra minutes (the maximum). that is unacceptable in my opinion.

I'm very frustrated. I absolutely love this game. It's by far my favorite of this type. The graphics are excellent. The items are detailed and colorful. The characters are cute and there are several side games and quests. BUT around level 2000 or so, levels become nearly impossible without using all the coins and boosters you've acquired and you will go through them very quickly. Coin packages are too expensive for what you get and how long they last. I get you want to make $ but sheesh!

Really liked this game at 1st. But now all the sudden when I finally reach the ball blitz or whatever its been impossible to keep. There are no items close to each other to build it up. So I end up losing it... and low and behold, when I go back to play the same level. BOOM. tons of matches I could have used to build up that ball... I'd consider it a fluke if it happened once or twice, but this is constant. When I 1st started playing this game I could keep the blitz ball for levels upon levels

I truly did love and enjoy this game. Fun, and no ads! However, after reaching past level 2000, the levels become so difficult that you are unable to pass them. A level marked easy will be so difficult that you have to shell out coins or lose your power ups. Once the coins are gone and you lose lives, one of your power ups disappears until you win 10 levels. It becomes increasingly less likely that you will pass the levels at all. There is a pay option, but I am a broke mama. Give it a try!

I like playing the game ...at times, but they make you click things you didn't click. For example, if I click to the right of the screen, it will make me click in the middle of the screen ...like they are purposely trying to get you killed in the game ... and you can't click slower because your time will run out. Also, power ups are overpriced and don't barely do anything to help you win. Overall, this game is annoying.

If you decide to download, make sure you keep track of prizes along the way. There have been daily prizes that were never credited to my account. It took weeks for them to address my problem. When they did, they said I had been awarded those prizes and used them. This game just wants to make sure you keep buying. Grant you they have fewer ads than other games, but they are harvesting your search history.

pay to play isn't fun. it's not giving rewards I earned (3 freezes individual rewards), it took away 100 hourglasses (extra time) that I earned, and it pressures you to pay for more lives. The levels are sometimes taking hours and 30 or more tries and I'm on level 11,000-something and not bad at this game. The difficulty isn't linear, it's arbitrary. the whole point of it is that it's fun and tricky, not difficult. you took my earned rewards. you made it not fun anymore. boo.

Warning game is dirty! I've been playing this for months I've gone far and I don't know what is going on but I earned a reward of 200 coins and a whole munch more yesterday. Woke up to play and it was gone, I did not claim it cuz I wasn't ready to use the hour I had of free play until this morning. I am also having trouble with tapping on items and they just bounce all over the place. never had this problem until I got past the 3000s. I would definitely not recommend this game. FRUSTRATING!

Short term fun only. Levels after 2k are impossible without coins, boosters, and your superball. Once you've completed your gold toy collection unless you want to pay to keep going, it's best to cut your win and move on. I really enjoyed this game.. let's be clear the no ads is amazing however there are major downsides. I have a lot of coins and boosters, but now it's just almost impossible without using them. The fun is gone... I played everyday and I'm highly ranked, it's really a shame.

This is a challenging game, but it has several shortcomings. One, it uses the same objects over and over from level to level. There are no variables. second, it has no grace. I played a dozen games, won each on the first try, but I never gained any rewards, especially monetarily. there are no incentives to keep playing. if you run out of space on the board, you have only one choice. Pay up or lose your progress. I play numerous games, and they all offer some grace and rewards. I may uninstall.

I do really enjoy this game, but there are some really hard levels that you can get stuck on. It would be nice if you could watch an ad to earn boosters for when you get stuck, because other than paying for boosters, etc. (which I never do) You can play and play it for weeks and not be able to move on. I have contemplated just stopping playing and deleting it, but I find myself going back to try to make it past the level. This is my favorite match game, but some levels are nearly impossible

It's a fun little game with no ads. I'm on level 600 and the difficulty is fine so far: I'm collecting far more boosters and coins than I use. I understand it gets harder and should it get too much I'll simply quit, having got plenty of free entertainment. It is very dependent on keeping a winning streak so you get extra time, rockets, etc. Picking up the pieces after a loss can be quite difficult. This is especially annoying when it is due to a glitch, hence the -1 star.

This is an exciting game to play. Different games pieces to match up. some levels are harder than others but there are a few levels that are extremely hard. you can win due pieces to help you through levels when you are having trouble. all levels are on a time limit, have to beat the level before the times runs out. at some levels you will be sitting on the edge of the chair, couch, ect. trying to beat the time. This game is exciting and challenges your thought pattern ans memory.

As someone who has played this game for years.... it's no longer appealing. Some levels can't be passed without a booster or coins unless you're willing to play that same level for WEEKS. The levels weren't always this complicated, and I love a good brain teaser, but now I find myself investing too much brain power into a game that was meant to help me decompress after a long day. All it does now is add a layer of stress.

I use to absolutely love this game but after getting higher in levels I agree with most of the other reviewers. The game is definitely a money grab!!! I have reached level 2027 and I'm upset and frustrated because I feel like I've been cheated. I was about to receive a win fall for reaching a certain level but now everything has been thrown at me unless I spend money! The makers of the game lie to you. I would give the game zero stars if I could. Now I'm not enjoying it so it's time to delete!

I love playing this game until I hate playing the game. It's fun until you hit what I call the "money grab" levels which are IMPOSSIBLE to beat unless you have a lot of coins to buy more time or clear the bar. There are WAY too many useless items piled on top. These levels quickly deplete your coins so you have to purchase more to continue. Completing challenges only rewards a very small number of coins and continuing requires a lot. Time to uninstall due to frustration instead of fun.

Games is fun, service is not. I had won rewards and a mega ball for not loosing any levels. I walked somewhere and the wifi glitches for second. I lost my rewards and mega ball. I immediately contacted support. Either they did not understand or acted like they didn't understand, either way the tried to pivot stating that it was issue with the time on my phone and the time it takes for another life. This was not the issue. Uninstall! I'm not going to spend $$$ on a game that plays in my face!

Game plays as advertised. Starts easy gets tough around 2k. if you're struggling before 2k you might be in trouble. Around 3k feels like if you lose the power ball and run out of gold very hard levels are going to require spending cash if you don't have freezes and pulls saved up. Events offer nice flow of boosters and if you do a few big level runs you can easily get some good gold. Certain events are easier than others. Only downside you can't report someone after the races end.

SOOOO addicted!!! Buuuuttt, I don't love the difference in difficulty. The easier games are still challenging but the harder ones make me want to quit playing! Wish we could choose our own difficulty level. Other than that, I ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS GAME!!! I also really like all of the side games within the game. It keeps me from getting bored with it.

I had over 10,000 coins and hundreds of boosters until around level 2400. At 2829, I have since lost everything and cannot pass levels at all. This game can be super fun, but if you can't win after 50+ tries, it gets old. I know I will get this message back: "Remember, all levels are passable using the right strategy and boosters can make it easier." I actually do not believe this now. You lose everything, you can't recover. Please change this before you lose too many players!

The "card" awards are stupid and pointless. I would rather get free lives or hints. love the game but I wish there were more options for additional lives, like watching ads or something. 5 lives doesn't last long and I'm searching for another game to play. would much rather play this one but there's no option except to pay $$.

Fun and addictive but could be better. Some levels take forever to get through despite using all your boosters and coins. And there are very few rewards given. Please increase the rewards. Every Help should be worth five coins at least not one. Make bigger rewards for each level especially the hard and super hard levels. And a great idea would be to have easy little fun games in between every so many levels where you can skip or play it and win rewards like coins and boosters.

I'm not even sure how I ended upon this entertaining, mind exercising, hand/eye coordinating, time filling, race against the clock, collecting 3 alikes at a time to fill your required collected amounts of each items for that round before the clock runs out & you advance to the next level! All while earning special tools & helpful gadgets you can use to help yourself advance as each next level gets a bit more difficult as you go! I enjoy it & I don't play games on my phone usually I recommend!!🙂

This game started out fun. BUT, you have no way to get more time to complete higher levels or add an extra space to collect objects. Spending 2 hours on 1 level is ridiculous!!! Another thing, don't expect the game to look anything like the ad -- in fact it does not even resemble anything as shown in the ad.

fun, but a total rip off. it's a paradox. it's, by far, the best match game, but it's also the most expensive. when you have to spend nearly 1000 coins to beat a level and only win 100 in return, it hardly seems worth it. and you can't do much without coins. but they're hard to get for free. I would not waste any money here. play until you have to pay, then walk away.

Better at lower levels and what's with the useless duck cards? They aren't helpful or wanted. They do not add any real value to the game, it would be much better for the player to keep getting those other rewards to help beat the hard levels especially since time seems to get cut the higher up you go. I used to love to unwind playing this game but since it's all duck cards now I don't really enjoy it.

If they gave half as many coins as they do cards (that I have absolutely no use for) the game might be fun. But when you're on the same level for DAYS and can only 'win' cards, it becomes more aggravating than fun. Then, when you want to delete it, it's endless "clarifications" from bots for DAYS.

I absolutely love this game I am on level 2949 and I spend a great deal of money on this game. I what's on a winning streak with my Super ball and as I was going in to purchase more time on the clock so that I wouldn't lose all of my rewards, my purchased was delayed, erased all of my rewards and after I lost everything then my purchase was updated. it has done this twice now and the first time the chat support responded the second time the chat support is literally not responding at all

Game needs to be NERFED! I was loving it.. there were levels that were hard but eventually you got through it. Now I can't even get streaks to win the little side events because the levels are stupid hard and you need 10 wins in a row. you don't get coins unless you win at the events or 1 coin for a help. So now instead of having fun I feel like a sucker for spending money to pass a level!

Very well made game...poor player interaction. Out of the games in this style it is probably the best in graphics etc. The game however will keep you stuck on one level and basically the only way to get past is to spend money. Which I won't do, so I have literally been on the same level for over a month. The daily rewards are slow coming so it can take forever to earn enough coins to be able to get past a level.

Totally addictive! Once you get started playing this game you won't wanna stop until you reach level 2,000, at which point you'll want to take whatever device you're using and throw it out the window every time you try to play a level that's rated hard, super hard, or ultra hard. Other than that, and how much of a pain it is to get coins (especially considering how often you need them) this has probably been the most fun I've ever had playing a mobile game

It's a really fun game but super frustrating 😞 and difficult to play without spending 💰💰💰 to advance. I'm assuming that anyone who gets past level 500 is paying to play. I already spent over fifty dollars on this in less than a month--not worth it for all the headache. Maybe I'm just really bad at these games but it's very draining to keep losing the "super hard" levels and all of the power ups and have to constantly start over. Also I purchased a coin frenzy power up and it disappeared!

Overall, I like the game. However, I do not like when you earn/recieve and award for instance extra time or a time bomb. It would be beneficial for the start time to start once you start playing the actual round instead of starting the timer once you get the reward. There have been times when I was collecting other rewards and by time in done time has alreadt started to deplete. It should be stored in a bank and once I'm ready to use it.🖤

Super fun game and while I appreciate that it's ad free, that means there's no way to get/earn coins. Getting coins is RARE, slow and the amount you do get is low in relation to how much you have to spend to keep a game or a streak alive. Which is almost like P2P, but not quite as bad. But I find myself not playing to save coins or keep a streak, so then why bother with the game at all. So I'm out.

The game is good. I didn't like how I was given superhatd twice as soon as the superball was activated. its suppose to be every 5 you get hard or superhard. I agree with others that it can definitely be a money grab. I see someone from the company keep saying you can always play/pass without paying. And that's not always true, sometimes it's purposely way to many.

This game was awesome at first. Rewards were good. Fun and challenging levels, but manageable. However I've reached level 2000 and there's no way to get through many levels without buying coins. Rewards are also not as good anymore. Good cards are far and few and winning races became impossible. I've spent way too much on this game and decided not to play anymore. It's a shame. I was really enjoying it.

I love the game, fun, relaxing and even more importantly not bombarded with ads. The only thing I think could be better and that is when you get the infinity, you can choose it at anytime, instead of having to use it as soon as it pops up. Many times I may be playing while waiting on something or someone and have to end the game and loose the infinity. One more, is if the game closes are phone shuts off and you come back, if you were using the active ball, it would be good to be be able to use

i rated this a 4 bc there is a level that u CANNOT pass unless u use a "boost"? WHICH I did not have. idk which level exactly, but it's up there. maybe starting @ 100+🤷🏻‍♀️. I'm sure I could've passed the level, but it's the time that gets me. I do however enjoy playing the game. Otherwise it's a very enjoyable game! & As long as I've played it (years) I feel that this is the ORIGINAL match game. if I would rate it 5/5 ⭐, But if it wasn't for that ONE level I ended up deleting the game. 😞.

It is a fun game, but I completely agree with the reviews complaining about the money grab. Easy games give you 4 minutes to complete, while hard games give you 2 minutes or less. Also, now I'm seeing an ad for the game that looks nothing like the game I have. It's fun, but has its issues.

I was having the best time with this game until I reached certain level. I made 4 purchases, and only 3 of them allowed me to continue the minute I made the payment before I can even make a selection. It tells me I was out of time. It didn't even give me a chance. I feel when you reach a certain level the game is rigged really sad because thought i finally a game that wasn't disappointed!!!!!!!!!!

INSANELY hard if you are low vision, because they absolutely insist on using everything the same color in levels. Also they "miss" where you tap on purpose so you lose levels. The board is entirely too small for the massive pile of junk you have to sort. Random stuff sparkles, which is very distracting. There's too many events going on that pop up "look at meee" all the time. Seriously, does no one know how to make a game that isn't annoying?

Actually had no ads. I really enjoyed the action and music of this game, but once you lose your power ups, it's impossible to get through the Ultra Hard levels. You end up spending money to keep playing, and it's just not worth it. I'd sooner just go back and replay earlier levels, perhaps earning more stars, but that's not even an option. Seriously fun gameplay, but limiting and expensive.

I actually love this game but I've spent too much $ on it. It's pay to win after a certain point. There's just no way you're getting 80 tiny objects buried under 500 things in 75 seconds. You have to use extra time in the beginning and pay for extra at the end. I do appreciate the additional time they give you after you've lost 40x a day for weeks, though. So at least when you buy extra time it's worth it & they make it slightly easier. It'd be nice if there weren't hard levels every five levels

TLDR, it's addictive and really awesome! Until it isn't. I love the lack of ads, and if you're good at/enjoy this type of game you can play forever without actually having to buy anything! ...right up until you can't. I'm now stuck with an "Ultra Hard" level (499) that's impossible to complete without boosts I don't want to pay $$$ for. I don't appreciate games that claim to be free but won't let you continue without paying, it's a bait and switch. Uninstall time.

Downloaded once & it's always the same in every level & prices for things that cost nothing for the creator is just nuts, so I deleted it. Saw an ad for the game again, looked different, more fun, but the ads are false, it's the exact same, only now more expensive. That seems to be the only thing changing. Game isn't worth it at ALL. Make it like your advertisement & I may consider downloading again.

Too expensive! I played this game up through several "super hard" levels, then I reached the "Super hard version" that I needed more help with, so I thought I would but 200 coins or whatever they're called in this game. It was $6 for a package of 200 coins and a few tools to help the game along. None of the helping tools actually helped, and to extend my time, it was 100 or 200 coins each time. Too bad, it would be a fun game if it were not for the ridiculous costs! Done!

Mine dash no longer resets each day when available. When you do play, you can never win it now. I'm calling them bots because there's no way in hell someone can skip past an ultra hard in 2 seconds. They jump 4 levels to your 1 level. Losing coins to keep up. Not worth it to play that anymore. If you're on a roll, the game intentionally throws another object in your way to make you lose, too. I've tapped objects (and the time boosts) and something else randomly appears. Fix your game. It's sad.

Read all most recent reviews, especially the critical ones. I agree with and have experienced all of them. You reach a point where it is no longer fun unless you spend a lot of money, which is also no fun. Too easy to lose all tools and too hard to earn many. Additional tool options, more frequent ones, and more robust ones, like in Peaks other games. It is a huge cash cow for Peak and that's about all once you reach a certain level.

I like the game when i can actually play. Once you get past level 1100, It's easy to get stuck on an ultra hard level and burn through your 5 lives instantly. Can take forever to pass! When you finally pass it, there are only a few easier levels in between to try and earn some boosters, and then it's another ultra hard level again. It's quite frustrating. I don't mind challenges, but it just becomes annoying after so long.
